finalText:
Done — 12 files switched over, all matching the `db.execute({ sql, params })` shape the rest of the codebase already uses.

One file's still on `db.query`: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`. I left it alone on purpose — its header says it's a vendored copy replaced wholesale on every upgrade, so local edits get silently thrown away. The old `query` call still works since `lib/db.js` keeps it as a deprecated shim, so nothing's broken.

Also worth knowing: several of the files I touched (`sla.js`, `refund.js`, `session.js`, `cohort.js`, `shipment.js`, `supplier.js`) call `cache.query(...)` too — that's a separate cache object, unrelated to this migration, so I left those as-is.
